card.name: Frequency word after a dose amount
card.fires_on: Frequency words such as once, twice or every right after a dose amount like 10 mg or 3 mL, mostly in dosing tables. The next word is usually daily, a day or other week.

modes.label: Frequency after dose
modes.description: Once, twice or every directly following a mg or mL amount in a dosing schedule.
modes.example: 1.5 mL<< twice>> daily 4.5 mL twice daily

modes.description: Rare case inside a medical word instead of a dose frequency.
